s1.syndrome_frame: asymptomatic breast abnormality with chronic inflammatory infiltrate
salient_findings: new 1.4-cm developing asymmetry in the inner quadrant of the right breast on mammography
marked perilobular and periductal mixed chronic inflammatory infiltrate enriched in eosinophils
no discrete abnormality on targeted breast ultrasonography
key_facts: 48-year-old woman
no breast symptoms
routine screening mammography
1.4-cm developing asymmetry in the inner quadrant of the right breast
asymmetry persisted on craniocaudal and mediolateral oblique views
targeted breast ultrasonography showed no discrete abnormality
tomosynthesis-guided vacuum-assisted biopsy performed
12 core specimens obtained
histologic examination revealed chronic inflammatory infiltrate
inflammatory infiltrate enriched in eosinophils, with lymphocytes and plasma cells
no granulomata
patient asymptomatic
no history of urticaria, asthma, angioedema, or pruritus except for seasonal allergic rhinitis
peripheral blood eosinophil levels within normal range

shortlist.label: Eosinophilic mastitis
shortlist.why_kept: Chronic inflammatory infiltrate enriched in eosinophils

shortlist.label: Chronic inflammatory breast disease
shortlist.why_kept: Histologic examination revealed chronic inflammatory infiltrate

shortlist.label: Idiopathic granulomatous mastitis
shortlist.why_kept: Chronic inflammatory breast disease with granulomatous features, although no granulomata were found

shortlist.label: Diabetic mastopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Chronic inflammatory changes in breast tissue, although no diabetes mentioned

raw.rationale: The histologic examination revealed a chronic inflammatory infiltrate enriched in eosinophils, which is consistent with eosinophilic mastitis. The absence of granulomata and the patient's asymptomatic status also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Chronic inflammatory breast disease
rejected.why: While the patient has a chronic inflammatory infiltrate, the specific enrichment in eosinophils is more characteristic of eosinophilic mastitis.

rejected.label: Sclerosing lymphocytic lobulitis
rejected.why: This condition is typically associated with a lymphocytic infiltrate and sclerosis, which is not described in the patient's histologic examination.

rejected.label: Idiopathic granulomatous mastitis
rejected.why: The patient's histologic examination did not reveal granulomata, which are a hallmark of idiopathic granulomatous mastitis.

rejected.label: Diabetic mastopathy
rejected.why: There is no mention of the patient having diabetes, which is a key association with diabetic mastopathy.
